serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I’m close to that place…
I still…{{wi}} have this on my mind…
It keeps me awake at night…{{wi}} I need to do something about this…
I can see her face in my dreams.
It haunts me…
Was it my fault? Am I to blame for what happened to Shanice?
I didn’t even go to the police… {{wi}}I know it wouldn’t probably help, but…
She’s dead, that I’m certain of, but what about her family? Do they know what happened to her?
I don’t even know her last name, so I have no way of reaching out to them.
Maybe I should go back there? To the church?
Maybe there is some evidence, some clue to what actually happened?
I didn’t know that crazy nun girl that well, but I feel like it’s the right thing to do…
